source: User reports and live export fetched 2026-11-13: 667 Campaign fights, 6964 Campaign positions, 11 Arena games. Raw files in .wrangler/testing-balance/2026-11-13/.
basis: Merchant card stock rerolls 50 +50 each time per shop. Hunter: Trail of Blood and Bloodsong cost 0->1 both upgrades; Bloodsong immediate Might 2/3->1/2; Pack Frenzy Might 3/4->2/3. Reaping Attack-card Command companion HP conversion 1/2->1/4 rounded up; hero half unchanged. Shatter held Spell Power halves above 20; Obsidian Aegis scaling halves above +10 Barrier. No HP changes.
evaluationScope: Historical observed evidence, not new measured parity: 65 Spellblade fights all rules108, before rules109 diminishing returns. WJKHm6jFwn (Drago Tier12) recorded a 2158-damage turn8 attributed to lo~starforged-blade+; nGS3r3KxdN recorded 1823 on turn5 including 1376 Blade and 447 meteor-jab+. Anonymous player hashes cannot confirm sacacweeda attribution. These observations establish historical high ceilings, not a current exploit. No replay resimulation or balance simulations run.
target: Typical Arena games of 10 or more own turns and roughly 50% or better Drago clears with optimized decks remain playtest targets.

ratings.name: Paladin
ratings.setup: Hunter pays 1 Mana for two previously free Might engines; immediate Bloodsong Might reduced. Other native starts unchanged. Merchant rerolls trade shards for consistency.
ratings.recovery: Held shop cards and non-card services survive rerolls; each reroll consumes funds needed for purchases. Spellblade Aegis recovery at high held Power grows more slowly; early Barrier unchanged.
ratings.rareReliance: Hunter common Trail of Blood becomes paid setup, rare Bloodsong and Pack Frenzy reduced. Aegis is rare; base Shatter change affects all Fracture decks. Free mixing can import these effects.
ratings.scaling: Hunter permanent Might remains uncapped from repeated ordinary sources. Reaping Command conversion halves, rounded per hit. Spellblade Shatter held-Power contribution and Aegis recurring Barrier keep growing at half rate past their thresholds. Existing Blade/spending diminishing returns remain.
ratings.rationale: Native cards unchanged; freely mixed builds can acquire changed cards. Shop rerolls affect every Campaign class.
ratings.watch: Compare native and mixed burst, defense, companion-command and resource engines in IV–VII, VIII–X, XI–XII and Arena both seats. Track setup cost, recovery, 11+ own-turn growth and shard opportunity cost.
ratings.confidence: Low for current balance; historical observations predate current scaling rules. Deterministic tests establish implementation only.
ratings.pacing: Slower setup and extreme scaling may extend fights, but no 10+ own-turn parity is claimed.

ratings.rareReliance: Hunter common Trail of Blood becomes paid setup, rare Bloodsong and Pack Frenzy reduced. Aegis is rare; base Shatter change affects all Fracture decks. Free mixing can import these effects.
ratings.scaling: Hunter permanent Might remains uncapped from repeated ordinary sources. Reaping Command conversion halves, rounded per hit. Spellblade Shatter held-Power contribution and Aegis recurring Barrier keep growing at half rate past their thresholds. Existing Blade/spending diminishing returns remain.
ratings.rationale: Directly affected class; magnitude of competitive change unmeasured.
ratings.watch: Compare native and mixed burst, defense, companion-command and resource engines in IV–VII, VIII–X, XI–XII and Arena both seats. Track setup cost, recovery, 11+ own-turn growth and shard opportunity cost.
ratings.confidence: Low for current balance; historical observations predate current scaling rules. Deterministic tests establish implementation only.
ratings.pacing: Slower setup and extreme scaling may extend fights, but no 10+ own-turn parity is claimed.

corrections: Previous snapshots preserved. Carried Arena grades are historical hand estimates, not reassessed grades after these changes.

Real server observations are now available; previous local-only fixture inspections missed the public export documented in tools/src/adminAccess.ts. Player identity cannot be established from anonymized exports.
Reaping currently affects Attack-card Commands, not autonomous companion actions. This scope is preserved while the companion conversion rate changes.
No Spell Power cap or broad generator nerf; the first20 held Spell Power retains its Shatter/Aegis value. Older rules108 burst is not presented as evidence that rules112 still has the same strength.

The earlier local 0.270.0 candidate snapshots describe this work before discovering releases 0.270–0.273 on origin. Those snapshots are preserved; 0.274.0/rules113 is the actual combined release candidate, including the earlier Rift Heart and enemy phase assessments.
